grounding.quote:
Its instance premises are: (a)
one specification may have several realisations; (b) realisations, frames
and the method are made by fallible constructors and relied on by actors
who did not make them; (c) qualification evidence comes from a finite set
of cases, run by actors inside declared envelopes.

concepts.label: Conformance, equivalence and qualification
concepts.definition: F7 concerns whether realisations, frames and the method are fit for their claims. Its instance premises allow several realisations per specification, fallible constructors and reliance by other actors, and finite qualification cases within declared envelopes. These are work conditions, not commitments or consequences of finite capacity alone. The cited actor-change premise permits reacquisition of declared sources, not private memory.

grounding.quote: conformance, semantic equivalence, computational equivalence and categorical equivalence are separate claims with separate evidence, and no rung implies another.

concepts.label: Conformance and equivalence claims
concepts.definition: Conformance is satisfaction of a specification by interpreted realisation behaviour under a declared interpretation contract and independent judgment. Semantic, computational and categorical equivalence are distinct claims; preservation of identities and composition by a map is a further claim.

grounding.quote: a layered specification is sufficient when a competent actor can derive a conformant next layer from each layer, not necessarily uniquely.
a reconstruction return states semantic conservation, demonstrated reduction and mere relocation as separate claims with separate evidence

concepts.label: Layered sufficiency and reconstruction
concepts.definition: Layered sufficiency concerns a competent finite actor's ability to derive a conformant next layer from each layer. A reconstruction return distinguishes semantic conservation, demonstrated reduction and mere relocation.

grounding.quote: a conformance case names its subject, the mechanism under test, an independently specified expected distinction and its status, and a status names what exists.
a trial of bounded construction declares its per-actor context cap and total-work budget before each run

concepts.label: Conformance cases and bounded trials
concepts.definition: A conformance case identifies its subject, mechanism, independently specified expected distinction and status. A bounded construction trial additionally declares actor context and total-work bounds.

grounding.quote: ## 7. Qualification of frames and of the method

concepts.label: Qualification of frames and of the method
concepts.definition: Document section grouping qualification of frames and qualification of the method; the heading alone adds no test or verdict.

grounding.quote:
A candidate frame ([REFERENCE_FRAME](REFERENCE_FRAME.md)) is qualified in
proportion to its claims (P6, P2).

Whether the actor class
operates the frame adequately is adequate attention

concepts.label: Frame qualification, fit and adequate attention
concepts.definition: Qualification of a candidate frame in proportion to its claims. Capability includes separately evaluated fit and adequate attention: context fit compares measured selected-representation size with declared capacity; adequate attention concerns evidenced actual use on declared tasks and conditions.

grounding.quote:
The method is qualified the way it qualifies anything else. Qualification
of generic method sufficiency consumes the work boundary (FOUNDATIONS §2),
the construction and assessment relation of ACTIVATION §1 and the layered
sufficiency of §6; it creates no second process.

concepts.label: Method self-qualification
concepts.definition: Method self-qualification uses the ordinary qualification process, the work boundary, construction/assessment relation and layered sufficiency. Its population is every claimed function and failure relation. It includes qualification of changed derived guidance and a recoverability benchmark using fresh actors and published documents.

grounding.quote:
An operational
profile owns only its own bindings, the terms and choices it adds for its
operation.

concepts.label: EXECUTIVE_BASELINE
concepts.definition: Optional tier-3 operational profile mapping Executive, Worker, Reviewer and specialist frames onto tiers 1 and 2. It owns its direct-entry additions, empirical revision boundary, frame mappings and allocation explanation, specialist catalogue, engagement procedure, Worker value readings and adoption/configuration/qualification/closure records. It imports, without redefining, FOUNDATIONS, REFERENCE_FRAME, ACTIVATION, EVALUATION, SPEC_METHOD, PRODUCT_DEFINITION and ASSURANCE.

grounding.quote:
-> a sufficient direct Worker activation, or coordination where material
  -> when coordinated: Executive locks outcome and basis, holds a finite ready frontier
  -> Worker and the applicable specialist evaluations; Reviewer only where required
  -> closed results, technical triage where applicable, declared conjunction
  -> existing bounded decision authority, result recording, next lawful action
  -> updated basis, coverage, residuals and frontier
  -> repeat or stop

concepts.label: Canonical engagement projection
concepts.definition: Canonical engagement projection: existing authority, complete method basis including REFERENCE_FRAME, exact Product or Product-chain outcome/workspace and known evaluations/dependencies/residuals support sufficient direct Worker entry or material coordination. Coordination locks outcome/basis and finite readiness, obtains applicable Worker/specialist and required Reviewer evaluations, consumes closed results, applicable triage and declared conjunction, applies bounded decisions, records results and next lawful action, updates basis/coverage/residuals/frontier, and repeats or stops.

grounding.quote:
REFERENCE_FRAME owns the pure frame principles; this member owns the
optional Executive, Worker, Reviewer and specialist mappings; PRODUCT_DEFINITION
§7 owns the Product-binding relation, and each adopting Product's authority
owns its concrete Project Reference-Frame Basis. The testing-frame
mappings this profile uses are ASSURANCE's.

concepts.label: Profile ownership boundary
concepts.definition: Ownership boundary distinguishing pure frame principles, optional profile mappings, the Product-binding relation and each adopting Product's concrete Project Reference-Frame Basis. Execution, result, assessment, assurance, design, identity and release rules remain with their cited owners.

grounding.quote:
Where the
executive configuration is selected, the directly entering frame is Worker
(Writer) and the coordinating frame Executive. A role or frame name alone
creates no review obligation either (P0, P6).

concepts.label: Engagement applicability
concepts.definition: Direct entry and coordinated engagement are conditional branches under ACTIVATION. In the executive configuration the entering frame is Worker/Writer and the coordinator is Executive; a name creates no review obligation.

grounding.quote:
Its instance premises hold where
the executive configuration is selected; they are adopted with it and do
not follow from the foundations (P1, P6):

concepts.label: Engagement foundation-to-law trace
concepts.definition: F16's foundation-to-law trace separates commitments, imported consequences, adopted instance premises and profile/Product choices. It imports F1 frames/context, F2 transitions/configuration, F3 results/combination, F4 work-state/reuse, F5 cost, F6 claims/assessment, F15 lineage and F13 carriers. P0 is reported recovered; P1, P2, P3, P4a and P6 independent; P4b derived from P0/P2 with non-reacquirable step facts; P5 derived from P0/P6 with the open-world premise. I1 separates bounded changes from delivery attention, I2 locates every decision grant in existing authority, and I3 assumes finite, fallible, possibly probabilistic actors. Instance premises apply when this configuration is selected, not as deductions from foundations.

concepts.label: Empirical revision boundary
concepts.definition: Delivery practice, observed failures and repeated Product drift provide evidence for frame selection, qualification and revision. Resets, repair loops, moving subjects, proof masking and duplicated authority are possible misfit signals, not verdicts or a universal architecture.

grounding.quote: ## 5. Profile terms

concepts.label: Profile terms
concepts.definition: Document grouping for the profile's terms; the heading alone does not define additional terms.

grounding.quote:
An engagement frame is a frame (REFERENCE_FRAME §1) whose evaluation family
concerns selecting, constructing, assessing or disposing governed work.
Executive, Worker and Reviewer are this profile's engagement frames (P1).

concepts.label: Engagement frame
concepts.definition: A frame whose evaluation family concerns selecting, constructing, assessing or disposing governed work. Executive, Worker and Reviewer are this profile's engagement frames.

grounding.quote:
A specialist frame is an activated Product, requirement, design, identity,
release, domain, implementation, test, operational, historical or
capability frame that one engagement evaluation needs.

concepts.label: Specialist frame
concepts.definition: An activated Product, requirement, design, identity, release, domain, implementation, test, operational, historical or capability frame needed by an engagement evaluation.

grounding.quote:
A generic specialist-frame family is a reusable evaluation-family archetype
of this profile (§11).

Product, Product Composition, Design, Design Component, Public Boundary,
Entity, Operator, Owner, Effect, Reuse/Foundation, Install and Proof.

concepts.label: Generic specialist-frame family
concepts.definition: Reusable evaluation-family archetype preserving a recurring distinction. The twelve available families are Product, Product Composition, Design, Design Component, Public Boundary, Entity, Operator, Owner, Effect, Reuse/Foundation, Install and Proof. They are not mandatory actors, stages, components, services, files or runtime types.

grounding.quote:
Testing frame, authoritative Product path and material combinatorial
complexity are tier-2 terms defined in ASSURANCE §7. This profile uses them
as defined there and adds nothing to them (P1).

concepts.label: ASSURANCE-owned terms
concepts.definition: Testing frame, authoritative Product path and material combinatorial complexity are imported tier-2 terms owned by ASSURANCE §7; this profile adds nothing to their definitions.

grounding.quote:
Executive is this profile's label for the frame that selects or confirms
the bounded activation configuration and consumes closed Worker and
Reviewer results under existing project decision authority.

concepts.label: Executive
concepts.definition: Frame selecting or confirming bounded activation configuration and consuming closed Worker/Reviewer results under existing project decision authority. It holds the complete Product view and current MVP/release mandate needed for priority, disposition and next authorised action; it is not a universal semantic owner, controller, manager service or runtime observer.

grounding.quote:
Worker is this profile's label for the constructor role of ACTIVATION §1
activated as a frame. It owns construction and self-review inside its exact
intake, through the operation authority inherited from the governing work
relation.

concepts.label: Worker
concepts.definition: ACTIVATION's constructor role activated as a frame, responsible for construction and self-review within exact intake and inherited operation authority.

grounding.quote:
It
evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed result, with evidence-bound
technical triage when a finding exists.

concepts.label: Reviewer
concepts.definition: Independent live-surface evaluation activated as a frame and consumed by ACTIVATION's assessment relation, governed by EVALUATION's independence, traceability, assurance-boundary and qualification-freeze rules. It evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed result with evidence-bound technical triage when a finding exists.

grounding.quote:
Current-boundary effect is the Executive's recorded determination of what
one finding does to the current promotion boundary: it blocks it, requires
narrowing it, or may remain an explicit residual. It is a decision
projection, a state this profile declares, not a result and not a
disposition (§8)

concepts.label: Technical triage and decision projections
concepts.definition: Technical triage assesses one finding against its exact claim and basis. Severity grades manifested consequence; priority orders response against Product outcome, likelihood/exposure, mandate, reversibility, dependencies, delay cost and capacity. Current-boundary effect records blocks, requires narrowing, or may remain an explicit residual. These are distinct from the frame result and disposition; boundary effect has no core value or independent deciding force.

grounding.quote:
A work result is the Worker's closed output to its declared consumer; in
the coordinated branch that consumer is the Executive. It exists only after
a successful Worker activation.

concepts.label: Work result
concepts.definition: Worker's closed output to its declared consumer, which is Executive in the coordinated branch. Its five construction-availability carriers refine the predicate that a candidate is available; ACTIVATION owns their causes and total, exclusive core-value mapping. They are neither new dispositions, assessment nor acceptance.
conditions: A Worker activation has succeeded.

grounding.quote:
Elsewhere this profile stabilises the review subject through an immutable
identity or an equivalent exact-subject relation sufficient for the claimed
assessment. The profile creates no new lifecycle state named `frozen` (P3,
P6).

concepts.label: Exact candidate
concepts.definition: Subject identity required by transition evidence and review traceability. Generic method qualification freezes the construction result before material reference exposure under its applicable rule; elsewhere an immutable identity or equivalent exact-subject relation stabilises the subject sufficiently for the assessment. No lifecycle state named frozen is created.

grounding.quote:
Where that basis adopts
this profile, the projection records the selected profile mapping, exact
outcome, actor envelopes, evidence coordinates and revision conditions
needed in addition to the Product binding (§16). It is not a second
frame-basis definition and mints none of the authority it projects (P6).

concepts.label: Baseline-adoption projection
concepts.definition: Projection consuming that basis and recording the selected profile mapping, exact outcome, actor envelopes, evidence coordinates and revision conditions additional to the Product binding. It defines no second basis and creates no authority.
conditions: The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis adopts this profile.

grounding.quote: ## 6. Executive attention, evaluation and action

concepts.label: Executive attention, evaluation and action
concepts.definition: Document grouping for Executive attention, evaluation and action; the heading alone adds no operation or authority.

grounding.quote:
`U` is the durable inventory of known material evaluations that do not have
a closed result applicable to the current basis. `M` is the finite,
dependency-ready part selected for the next activation. The frontier is the
inventory's readiness relation; the closed-result ledger records the
returned results, their predicates, subject, basis, evidence and residuals.

concepts.label: Attention cycle, frontier and ledger
concepts.definition: U is the durable inventory of known material evaluations lacking an applicable closed result on the current basis; M is its selected finite dependency-ready part. The frontier is the readiness relation. The closed-result ledger records returned results, predicates, subject, basis, evidence and residuals. An applicable stop is an admitted work stop, including authority, capability or resource limits.

grounding.quote:
Before activation and before disposition, the Executive revalidates five
locks (P3, P6, P2):

concepts.label: Drift locks
concepts.definition: Five checks before activation and disposition: outcome lock preserves Goal/Product outcome, boundary/re-entry class, mandate and triage policy; basis lock requires exact current subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology, evidence, time and candidate coordinates; Product-role lock preserves distinct lineage identities and exact Install binding; authority lock preserves semantic, evaluation, operation, decision, acceptance and publication grants/owners; coverage-and-return lock requires each material evaluation/interaction closed or explicit residual and each consumed result on its declared return relation.

grounding.quote:
Each Development Product role binds one exact underlying
Install identity. Each edge names its source and target roles, its governing
authority and contracts, its lifecycle, its evidence boundary, its refusal
and its invalidation

concepts.label: Product-chain basis
concepts.definition: A basis for one Product or an explicit directed Product chain, distinguishing every mutable Source Project, current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product and composition edge. Each Development Product role binds one exact Install; each edge records source/target roles, governing authority/contracts, lifecycle, evidence boundary, refusal and invalidation.

grounding.quote:
3. frame topology records disjointness, overlap, conjunction, translation
   or composition among the evaluations actually used (REFERENCE_FRAME §7),
   while evaluation independence and Reviewer assurance independence stay
   separate activation relations.

concepts.label: Non-hierarchical frame configuration
concepts.definition: Distinct structures are authority precedence for work/configuration/disposition/re-entry, temporal/evidence communication carrying packets/results, and frame topology for disjointness, overlap, conjunction, translation and composition. Evaluation independence and Reviewer assurance independence remain separate activation relations. Structures may align when warranted but never become one hierarchy. One activated evaluation combines an engagement frame, material specialist frames, exact subject/basis and capable actor.

grounding.quote:
It is
one configuration, selected where it fits the task, not an inventory of
roles that all work needs.

concepts.label: The executive configuration
concepts.definition: Configuration allocating construction to Worker, specialised as Writer for documents/records; required assessment to Reviewer; and cross-task coordination and bounded disposition to Executive. It fits successive bounded tasks needing separate construction and delivery attention. Finite actor contexts respectively concern one causal cone, one exact claim/evidence, and outcome/frontier/closed-result ledger. It is one lawful configuration, not the method default or a universal role inventory.
conditions: Selected by existing authority where the allocation fits the task.

grounding.quote:
It allocates construction to the Worker frame, specialised as Writer for
documents and records

relations.meaning: The source configuration allocates construction to Worker, with Writer specialisation for documents/records; this allocation supplies no new operation grant.
conditions: The executive configuration is selected.

grounding.quote:
assessment, where it is required, to the Reviewer
frame

conditions: The executive configuration is selected.
Assessment is required.

grounding.quote:
coordination across tasks to the Executive frame, which disposes
within the decision grant existing authority admits

relations.meaning: Cross-task coordination and disposition within existing admitted decision authority are allocated to Executive.
conditions: The executive configuration is selected for coordination.

grounding.quote:
returns a closed result, with evidence-bound
technical triage when a finding exists.

relations.meaning: Reviewer returns evidence-bound triage with the closed assessment result; decision projections remain outside that assessment authority.
conditions: A finding exists in the exact evaluated subject.

grounding.quote:
in
the coordinated branch that consumer is the Executive.

relations.meaning: The coordinated work result returns to Executive as declared consumer; returning does not itself activate another frame or authorise continuation.
conditions: Worker activation succeeded.
The coordinated branch is selected.

grounding.quote: the projection records the selected profile mapping

relations.meaning: The adoption projection records the selected profile mapping without adopting the profile by itself, defining a second basis or creating authority.
conditions: The Product-owned basis adopts the profile.

grounding.quote: Evidence for one claim is never reported as a result for another

constraints.statement: Several realisations may conform without unique derivation or incumbent equality. Material behavioural alternatives require owner-declared latitude or repair before decision-complete design is claimed. Conformance entails neither behaviour identity outside the specification nor equal cost. Each equivalence rung needs its own evidence; none implies another. Categorical equivalence additionally requires applicable Formal-fragment items, a quasi-inverse functor and natural isomorphisms on a stated domain; structure preservation is a further claim. The claim author owns domain, workloads and architecture H; the specification owner owns interpretation contract/latitude. Evidence cannot be relabelled as another claim's result.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed rung definitions and applicable Formal-fragment requirements are referenced but not supplied.

grounding.quote: Reconstruction of an accepted relation may reuse its exact current basis and sufficient evidence after checking applicability and invalidation; reconstructability requires a correct route, not its execution at every use, grants no restart authority and does not excuse stale success
the reduction measure, its baselines and the traced paths: the candidate's design, declared before the trace

constraints.statement: Failure of competent derivation indicates an upper-layer defect; hiding major unresolved ambiguity at a boundary is insufficient. Reconstruction span follows the claim. Reuse requires exact current basis, sufficient evidence and applicability/invalidation checks; reconstructability requires a correct route, not execution at every use, and grants neither restart authority nor stale success. New material counterexamples still challenge accepted relations. Conservation, demonstrated reduction and relocation need separate evidence; no byte/size measure proves any. RELEASE supplies conservation reading/dispositions, while candidate design declares reduction measures, baselines and traced paths before tracing.
constraints.uncertainty: Layer diagnoses and detailed conservation rules depend on unsupplied SPEC_METHOD and RELEASE sections.

grounding.quote: after freeze, the evaluator compares the frozen result with the mandatory governing semantic basis. A separately held expected or reference outcome is optional and non-authoritative evidence; a lawful alternative construction the basis permits passes.

constraints.statement: Comparison uses the mandatory governing semantic basis. Separately held references are optional non-authoritative evidence; lawful alternatives permitted by the basis pass. Subjective similarity is insufficient. Byte/structural identity, uniqueness, determinism and incumbent equality are not generic criteria. Out-of-envelope construction cannot indict generic method sufficiency.
conditions: A frozen construction is being compared.
exceptions: Reference equivalence is required when the governing basis explicitly requires it.

grounding.quote: counts the context transferred across every delegated actor, and keeps its acceptance criteria independent of the constructing actor
A case passes when the expected distinction is observed and no coerced success appears anywhere in the result

constraints.statement: Running a case is not passing it: only an independent assessor records a pass, requiring the expected distinction and no coerced success anywhere. A case impossible to run with its declared subject is explicitly not run, has no result and receives no core value; this revision receives no pass without its run and assessment. Before each bounded-construction run declare per-actor context cap and total-work budget, count context transferred across every delegated actor, and keep acceptance criteria independent of the constructor. The source locates these declarations in eight CONFORMANCE §2 trials, with context/resource measurement owned by ACTIVATION.
constraints.uncertainty: Required-basis-over-cap cases, varied task ordering for probabilistic repetition, case inventories and measurement procedures are cross-references, not supplied specifications.

grounding.quote:
9. Result-consumption test: can a declared consumer use the closed result
   without importing hidden frame context?

constraints.statement: Minimum qualification asks nine questions: can competent actors produce declared-algebra results for representative in-domain evaluations; can fresh competent actors reconstruct activation from declared packets without hidden history; do material changes affect results where expected; do excluded unrelated changes leave results stable where expected; does stale/mismatched/ambiguous basis invalidate or refuse evaluation; does selection preserve semantic/decision authority and exact inherited operation authority for every material construction, transformation, admission, publication or mutation; are claimed representative historical/constructed violations detected; can the actor class hold and operate the frame within its envelope; and can a declared consumer use the closed result without hidden context. Qualification binds exact revision, actor envelope, evaluation family, basis class and evidence conditions, never a generically named unevaluated population.

grounding.quote:
A size measurement, or any byte or token
threshold, establishes fit and nothing about attention; a frame that fits
is not thereby adequately attended.

constraints.statement: Fit and adequate attention are evaluated separately. Context fit uses ACTIVATION §2 step 3 measurement against capacity; other dimensions follow RF-014. Attention requires declared-class actors actually applying the frame to declared tasks/conditions, assessed against governing-source expectations recorded before results are opened, using an independent assessor where the claim requires one. Actual-use evidence binds revision, class, tasks and conditions and provides no universal attention score. Fit is necessary under finite attention but never qualifies attention. Time, spend and other limits belong to the selected execution binding under ACTIVATION §6. Logical review and unassessed runs do not supply actual-use evidence for the revision.
constraints.uncertainty: The other envelope dimensions, measurement procedures and independent-assessment applicability rules are not fully supplied.

grounding.quote:
The constructor, freeze,
assessor, acceptance and release protocols are supplied by the governing
authority; this member does not select a particular protocol for those
roles.

constraints.statement: A fresh competent constructor works within declared capability/context/configuration using only declared ordinary method, authority surfaces and trial subjects. An independently authorised evaluator has declared governing basis and comparison predicate. Material expected/reference outcomes, source exemplars, incumbents, author memory and ad hoc rescue are withheld until construction freezes wherever early exposure would compromise independence; comparison then evaluates the frozen result against the mandatory relation population under §6. RF-013 owns activation reconstructability; governing authority supplies constructor, freeze, assessor, acceptance and release protocols.
constraints.uncertainty: The source assigns protocol ownership but selects no concrete protocol.
conditions: Generic method sufficiency is being qualified.
exceptions: Withholding until freeze is conditional on earlier exposure compromising reconstructive independence.

grounding.quote: | material composition | a case requiring cross-frame execution declares composition, order where material, closure, failure and the conservation of semantic, operation and decision authority; a case not requiring composition stays uncomposed |

constraints.statement: Required representative observations cover every claimed function/failure relation: declare derives a frame set from governed workspace, outcome, practices, capability envelopes, evaluation inventory, authority and residual boundary, refusing missing authority/evaluation basis; activate succeeds on exact subject/basis and capable actor, while stale, ambiguous, topology-mismatched, unauthorised or capability-incompatible cases refuse or return applicable closed pressure; evaluate exhibits satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis, material sensitivity and established irrelevance stability; conjoin decides compatible closed results by declared rule, returns conflict for conflict, indeterminate for mandatory indeterminacy, invalid_basis for basis mismatch, and cause-appropriate declared veto/deferral outcomes without flattening frame meaning; translate preserves coordinates/provenance, states loss and refuses identity/basis/authority/equality mismatch; audit_coverage maps evaluation, interaction, semantic/operation/decision authority, failure, capability and required independent/assurance-independent coverage to capable frames or explicit residuals, never closing by artifact/actor count; revise produces declared deltas for historical failure, topology/evidence/capability changes and identifies every affected prior activation/result/conjunction/coverage claim; result consumption needs no hidden context or authority, otherwise output insufficiency is reconstructability failure; material composition declares composition, material order, closure, failure and authority conservation, while cases needing none stay uncomposed.
constraints.uncertainty: Full method-function definitions, closed-pressure algebra and cause-specific veto/deferral outcomes remain with referenced owners.

grounding.quote:
an unevaluated function or branch stays open rather than
inheriting a whole-method verdict (P6; §1).

constraints.statement: A valid declaration and coverage result establish only declare and evaluated audit_coverage, with no implication for other relations. Each relation needs representative positive, boundary and falsifying cases. Every verdict states exact functions, revisions, actor envelopes, basis classes, result branches and evidence populations evaluated; unevaluated functions/branches remain open. Prior exemplars after freeze are optional comparison evidence, not mandatory answers unless the governing basis explicitly requires equivalence.

grounding.quote:
Digest integrity and index generation establish identity and structure,
not semantic fidelity or usability.

constraints.statement: Changed compressions, frame packets, skills and other projections are qualified against source-derived expected behaviour, including affected permissions, exclusions and invalidators. Native-use claims require an ordinary actor applying guidance through its declared entry and available context. Digests/indexes prove identity/structure only. Mechanical and operational claims require their own executable observations with applicable workload and operational assumptions; semantic agreement cannot substitute.
conditions: Derived guidance has changed or a native, mechanical or operational claim is made.

grounding.quote:
or if a post-exposure revision is
unclassified or is used to make the original frozen construction pass
retroactively (§3).

constraints.statement: The source declares qualification law false if competence or constructor envelope, evaluator authority/basis/predicate is undeclared; out-of-envelope construction indicts the method; supplemental method/authority inputs are undeclared; material reference/exemplar/incumbent/memory/rescue exposure before freeze compromises independence; comparison omits mandatory semantics, uses constructor instead of independent evaluator authority, or self-adjusts after viewing results; reference outcomes become authority; reference equivalence is imposed without basis requirement or omitted despite it; subjective similarity becomes proof; identity, uniqueness, determinism or incumbent equality substitutes for conformance/equivalence; or post-exposure revision is unclassified or retroactively passes the original frozen construction.
constraints.uncertainty: This records source-defined falsifiers, not a judgment that any has occurred.
conditions: Any listed falsifier occurs.

grounding.quote:
A document set that requires private validator knowledge, whole-corpus
loading or a prior actor's memory fails the benchmark regardless of its
content.

constraints.statement: A fresh actor using only published documents must recover governing relations with independently judged fidelity at measured reconstruction cost. Transferred context uses ACTIVATION's size measure; time/spend use the selected binding. Fidelity judgment is actual-use evidence; size is not fidelity evidence. Requiring private validator knowledge, whole-corpus loading or prior actor memory fails. Comparative claims predeclare exact baseline, task population, actor envelope, evidence conditions and measures; material differences remain explicit and limit inference, and baseline evidence creates no method authority. Report fidelity, reconstruction cost, task completion and detected material errors separately, with no substitution among measures.
conditions: Recoverability of a selected activation is measured.
exceptions: A comparison baseline is unnecessary for measuring the package's own recoverability; time and spend are measured where measurable.

grounding.quote:
Inclusion in an exact released cut or another admitted method basis makes
the profile available; it does not adopt it. Adoption requires a separately
accepted Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis

constraints.statement: The profile owns no execution protocol or Product binding. Each requirement is either exact application of an owning relation or an optional-profile adoption condition, neither a second amendment path. Owning clauses control conflicts and require profile revision. Availability in an exact cut/admitted basis is not adoption; adoption requires a separately accepted Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis. Mutable source, installed files, prompts, summaries and commentary neither select nor adopt it. Local axioms may carry an adoption decision without becoming constitutional owners.

grounding.quote: reuse is no authority transfer, and an assigned foundation role keeps its declared relation and owner

constraints.statement: REFERENCE_FRAME owns declarations, activations/outcomes, translation, coverage and revision; FOUNDATIONS owns core results/conjunction; ACTIVATION owns responsibility configuration/delegation, intake and complete construction/self-review/assessment/disposition/checkpoint/continuation. EVALUATION owns independence, assurance subjects/populations/freezes and proxy grants; TICKETS owns when independent assessment is required and exact-verdict traceability. Design-profile conservation supplies Worker intake; ASSURANCE's design-to-module route/unit law supplies unit ownership while §7 limits evidence altitude. Capability/foundation selection before material generic construction supplies proportional reuse without authority transfer. ASSURANCE and current Product/requirements/design/release owners select testing claims, paths, subjects, modes and populations. Product/requirements/composition/design/identity/release/domain/effect/interface/dependency/assurance owners supply specialist families without one architecture. Goals/Product/requirements/admitted work authority select work; accepted design supplies local structures; identity/project/proxy law bounds Executive identity; Product/release acceptance retains direct owner acceptance where required.
constraints.uncertainty: These are ownership assignments; detailed imported laws are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
- the direct route binds the same exact intake, operation territory,
  applicable obligations, evidence, stop conditions and declared result
  consumer as the coordinated route of §12; and
- a direct Worker (Writer) gains no review, ticket, diagram recreation or
  owner ceremony from using this profile.

constraints.statement: Select coordination under ACTIVATION where direct entry cannot cover material contexts, authority, capability or required independence. Direct entry separates contract admission from drafting, uses the smallest lawful TICKETS carrier and records satisfied conditions when finishing as Writer. Required assessment/owner decisions persist; discovered insufficiency withholds dependent effects and returns questions to their owners. Direct and coordinated routes bind the same exact intake, territory, obligations, evidence, stops and consumer; profile use adds no review, ticket, diagram recreation or owner ceremony. §12 transitions/§13 handoffs apply to the coordinated branch; direct closed results go to declared work authority/carrier with the same algebra and operation/decision separation. Both branches reuse valid C/J/O under ACTIVATION §7 and neither changes exact adopted basis nor supplies missing authority.
exceptions: Finishing as Writer is allowed only when the local outcome is sufficient, no independent assessment is required and no acceptance is reserved.

grounding.quote:
The Worker supplies the
candidate and never activates the Reviewer. The Reviewer evaluates and does
not implement.

constraints.statement: The three frames overlap as evaluations but form neither hierarchy nor actor topology. Worker supplies candidates and never activates Reviewer; Reviewer evaluates without implementation. Executive uses only decision authority already granted by Product, Goals, requirements, accepted design, ticket, identity or release law; Worker uses only admitted-intake construction/transformation authority. No label grants admission, publication, mutation or other operation authority. The four ASSURANCE testing frames—user acceptance, end to end, integration and unit—add no role, stage, authority or testing hierarchy. Broader evidence cannot establish module-owned law, and any number of narrower passes cannot establish unevaluated Product composition or user outcomes.

grounding.quote:
No row
names pillar 10, axiomatic calculus: this profile states no rule of the
a_c calculus and binds none.

constraints.statement: Imported consequences remain owned by their importing sources; profile/Product choices must not be represented as foundation deductions. Consumers apply rules and decide nothing beyond owning sections. The trace claims to account for lead and §§1–22, references pillars 1–9, and states no axiomatic-calculus rule or binding. The source's overview claims about coverage are represented as document assertions, not validated completeness.
constraints.uncertainty: Most linked consumer loci and the cited standing of consequences are outside the supplied sections.

grounding.quote: a seam without a result as a gap, and the composite is never `satisfied` while a gap or a non-satisfied mandatory seam remains

constraints.statement: Coverage is the union of contributions from activated frames, not visibility or one frame holding the whole workspace. A composite is satisfied only through its declared conjunction; every material seam is a mandatory result or required coverage, no frame dominant. Missing seam results are gaps, and any gap or non-satisfied mandatory seam prevents satisfied. Project conjunction rules select the non-satisfied composite value when several apply. Each of the twelve families needs declaration, acquisition path or authority-bound disposition. Refinement is frame dependency, not hierarchy.
constraints.uncertainty: Family questions/falsifiers and detailed declaration/conjunction procedures in §11 are not supplied.

grounding.quote: a closed `indeterminate` result or a review event satisfies no unresolved obligation; the closure condition of a work item (F13) is applied to the selected branch only
the failure table's first diagnosis routes evaluation and decides no verdict.

constraints.statement: A non-deciding frame returns a non-success value naming missing relation, coordinate, evidence, authority, capability or interaction. Executive asks all eight questions in the imported diagnostic order, checking cheaper causes before adding frames; the profile reads independence into question 3 and verifies specialist inputs before question 5. Upstream changes re-enter their owner, not an enlarged Executive frame; diagnostic routing is no verdict. Qualification is confined to evaluated revisions, envelopes, branches and populations. Mechanical checks and source-linked Reviewer evaluation are required together without substituting one for the other. Indeterminate never becomes satisfied, and review events close no unresolved obligation. Work-item closure applies to the selected branch.
constraints.uncertainty: The eight-question order, twenty-six trial obligations and twenty-four closure conditions are referenced but not enumerated in supplied text.
conditions: A frame cannot decide or profile qualification/closure is claimed.

grounding.quote:
- inability to perceive a known violation is evidence of a missing,
  misactivated, oversized or capability-incompatible frame (RF-014).

constraints.statement: One bounded authority selects active work and finite needed frames. Worker constructs one exact candidate, self-reviews, reports and stops. Where independent assessment is required, a separately activated Reviewer acquires sufficient exact live authority, subject and evidence, reuses valid computed facts and supplies its own judgment; it returns evidence-bound severity/technical implications without another implementation loop. Where coordination is required Executive prioritises/adjudicates the current Product mandate within its grant. Failure to perceive known violations is evidence of missing, misactivated, oversized or capability-incompatible frames. Misfit and Product-drift signals justify reevaluation, not a definite diagnosis, architecture or precedent authority. Useful implementations, scenarios, specialisations, dependencies, builders and downstream Products do not become the authored Product through shared visibility or delivery chains.
conditions: The profile's engagement relation is used.

grounding.quote:
A method member,
file, component or lens becomes a frame only when its evaluation, basis,
material manifold, authority, evidence, result algebra and capability
envelope are declared

constraints.statement: Frame status requires declaration of evaluation, basis, material manifold, authority, evidence, result algebra and capability envelope; merely naming a member/file/component/lens does not establish it.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced complete minimal-frame declaration may contain detail beyond this excerpt.
conditions: A method member, file, component or lens is claimed as a frame.

grounding.quote:
It names a recurring distinction that a project
either instantiates where material, has capable authority establish as
non-material for the governed outcome, or keeps as an explicit coverage
residual (P2, P6).

constraints.statement: Each recurring distinction is instantiated where material, established non-material to the governed outcome by capable authority, or retained as an explicit coverage residual. Families choose no carrier, component, actor, architecture, owner or implementation. Only material families are selected for the exact evaluation; material families lacking coverage cannot be dropped.

grounding.quote:
It acquires no admission, publication, acceptance or continuation
authority (P6).

constraints.statement: Worker construction and self-review stay inside exact intake and inherited operation authority; the role acquires no admission, publication, acceptance or continuation authority.

grounding.quote:
It does not implement the repair,
assign priority, apply disposition or activate the next frame (P6).

constraints.statement: Reviewer evaluates the exact subject and returns evidence, not repair implementation, priority, disposition or next-frame activation. Required independence needs separately activated assessment by someone other than the author; Worker self-review remains construction evidence and is not relabelled by disposition.
constraints.uncertainty: Full independence conditions and review-required boundaries belong to referenced EVALUATION and TICKETS sections.

grounding.quote:
Missing causal or repair evidence stays explicit. Where the missing
relation can change the evaluation, the Reviewer returns `indeterminate` or
`out_of_frame` pressure (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results); it does not invent precision and
does not send work sideways to the Worker (P5).

constraints.statement: Triage records affected claim/observed failure; Product-scale severity; causal assessment and confidence governed as quantified assurance; blast radius and affected users/paths/relations; available workaround/containment; repair complexity, regression risk and material dependencies; and residual uncertainty with reducing evidence. Missing causal/repair evidence stays explicit. If the missing relation can change evaluation, return indeterminate or out_of_frame pressure without invented precision or sideways work dispatch.
constraints.uncertainty: Quantified-assurance requirements and per-result triage projection are referenced, not fully supplied.
conditions: A finding exists; admissible evidence and actor capability support the particular triage claims.

grounding.quote:
A hard stop or a falsified mandatory claim cannot be
waived by lowering priority. An observation outside the exact claim
boundary cannot open another review round because it carries a severe
label (P6, P2).

constraints.statement: Reviewer grades severity; Executive assigns priority. Product-owned basis selects severity/priority scales, boundary cutoff and non-waivable hard stops, without a universal numeric scale; imported hard-stop classes are typical, not closed. Stops hold regardless of priority, cutoff or risk appetite. Severity, priority, frame result and boundary effect are four distinct values and none alone decides promotion blocking. A recorded blocks effect must meet EVALUATION §5's condition and reaches the core only through one existing disposition; only disposition decides acceptance. Lower priority cannot waive a hard stop or falsified mandatory claim; severe labels outside the exact claim cannot open review rounds.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete promotion-blocking predicate and hard-stop classes are outside the supplied source.

grounding.quote:
- `re_entry_requested(authority)` (`out_of_frame`): the Executive returns
  the question to the decision owner the value names; and
- `re_entry_requested(basis)` (`invalid_basis`): the Executive revalidates
  the basis lock (§6 Drift locks) before any further activation.

constraints.statement: candidate_ready maps to satisfied and supplies exact candidate/transition evidence for deciding review need, never accept. refused maps to falsified, names the prohibition/refusal counterexample, and requires Executive basis verification and existing authority application. incomplete maps to falsified, not indeterminate: residuals/stop basis separately identify unperformed evaluations with no result, performed undecidable evaluations retaining their own indeterminate, and whether bounded execution ended first; reactivation needs current permission. re_entry_requested(authority) maps to out_of_frame and returns to the named decision owner. re_entry_requested(basis) maps to invalid_basis and requires basis-lock revalidation before further activation. Cause selection and mapping belong to ACTIVATION, not the profile; no value is accepted progress merely because work occurred.
constraints.uncertainty: The full grounds for selecting these values remain in ACTIVATION §3.
conditions: After lawful Worker activation.

grounding.quote:
A capability, authority, stale-basis, ambiguous-basis or topology mismatch
known during activation is an `activation_refusal` with its cause, never a
synthetic Worker result (P5, P6).

constraints.statement: Activation refusal carries its owner-defined cause/core value to assigning authority or declared carrier and creates neither Worker activation nor Worker result. Known activation-time capability, authority, stale/ambiguous basis or topology mismatch cannot be fabricated into a work result. Results reference current computed classification, supporting evidence, residual judgments and original rulings in existing carriers, without reconstructing unchanged C/J/O at every handoff. Consumers check applicability and concrete invalidators; changed evidence revises affected results only, preserving originals and supported surviving claims.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete activation-refusal cause/core mapping is not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Where generic
method qualification applies (EVALUATION §7), its construction result is
frozen before material reference exposure as that clause requires.

constraints.statement: Review binds a stable exact subject, never a moving candidate identity. Apply the conditional qualification freeze before material exposure wherever its owner requires it; elsewhere stabilise to the claimed assessment's needed exactness. Stabilisation does not create a frozen lifecycle state.
conditions: A review or generic method qualification is performed.
exceptions: Outside generic method qualification an equivalent exact-subject relation may replace immutable identity if sufficient for the assessment.

grounding.quote:
3. authorised action selection: it assigns priority, determines the effect
   on the current promotion boundary, applies an existing disposition, and
   issues only the next already-authorised activation or action.

constraints.statement: Three inseparable duties concern one governed outcome. Attention management retains exact outcome/basis, Product-role map, evaluation inventory, dependencies, unresolved frontier, actor envelopes, mandate, triage policy and residual boundary, selecting the smallest dependency-ready set sufficient for the next decision within finite envelopes. Orchestration activates capable Workers/Reviewers/specialists, preserves exact subject/basis and consumes only closed results or declared translations. Action selection assigns priority/boundary effect, applies existing disposition and issues only already-authorised next actions. Executive need not hold the whole workspace or perform every evaluation; its role grants no Product meaning, implementation, mutation, acceptance, publication or other operation authority. Material effects remain with actors holding exact operation grants.
conditions: The executive configuration is selected.

grounding.quote:
A same-actor role transition is explicit and is recorded in
the existing work carrier before the effect; for that effect the actor is no
longer acting as Executive. Recording or delegating after an Executive edit
cannot authorise the edit retroactively (P6, P3).

constraints.statement: Executive modifies no candidate, Product or worktree bytes and performs no implementation effects. Access and small, test-only, reversible or obvious edits are no exceptions; neither is a construction/status/checkpoint operation grant. Mutation requires separately activated Worker/Writer with exact grant, subject and write territory. Same-actor transition must be explicit and recorded before the effect, when that actor ceases acting as Executive for it. Later recording/delegation cannot authorise prior edits.
conditions: An actor occupies the Executive frame in the selected executive configuration.

grounding.quote:
end this cycle when every mandatory evaluation is closed, governing authority
has retained every remaining residual consistently with the claim, or an
applicable stop condition holds; retain every unresolved obligation

constraints.statement: While U remains, an applicable stop preserves open obligations, results and required re-entry durably and ends with cause/bounded result. Otherwise select finite dependency-ready M fitting actors, activate on exact outcome/basis, isolate assurance-independent evaluations from unclosed peer results, and await relevant input when no other authorised decision is ready. Record every closed result, triage, residual and invalidator; use only declared conjunctions/translations; assign priority/effect under current mandate; withdraw affected reliance after subject/basis change until applicability is established; update U from coverage, dependencies, conflicts and discovered materiality. End under the source's alternatives—every mandatory evaluation closed, authority consistently retaining every remaining residual, or applicable stop—retaining every unresolved obligation. Ending proves neither Product success nor acceptance: closed results may be falsified and stops may leave no results. Return distinguishes closed results, unperformed evaluations, retained residuals and stop cause; success still needs outcome evidence and applicable closure/acceptance.
constraints.uncertainty: The source states termination alternatives but supplies no executable control semantics in this bounded interpretation.
conditions: An attention cycle is active.

grounding.quote:
A consumer receives the
closed result and its source routes, not the child's hidden reasoning
context (P6, P4a; ACTIVATION §7).

constraints.statement: Frontier and ledger must be durable/reconstructable; Executive acquires the material portion and exact owner routes/dependencies sufficient for the next decision, without every evaluator's working context. Severity, priority, boundary effect, disposition and next action remain distinct ledger entries even when policy maps them. Every return uses an explicit declared relation to Executive, conjunction or another frame, carries closed result/source routes and grants no activation/continuation by itself. Handoff, completion, model/tool output or shared actor cannot supply admission. Different candidates/bases/episodes retain identity; flattened projections establish no equality or translation. Subject/basis changes preserve history while current reliance follows owner-defined reuse law.

grounding.quote:
Silence proves neither progress nor
failure. A genuine blocker or material risk is investigated, with
intervention where required, within existing grants; unknown status alone
does not establish a stalled Worker (P5, P6).

constraints.statement: Default re-entry triggers are decision-relevant closed results, material exceptions/changed basis, owner requests and declared deadlines/checkpoints. While Workers execute grants and no other authorised decision is ready, wait without repeated unfinished-work inspection, unchanged-judgment replay or needless status requests. Preserve frontier, return conditions and valid support; refresh affected support on material observations and revalidate locks before activation/disposition. Waiting waives no verification, evidence, independent assessment, consumption, authority or closure duty. Fallback declares purpose, cadence/checkpoint, evidence target and stop/escalation condition. Investigate genuine blockers/material risks and intervene where required within grants; silence/unknown status is neither progress nor failure. Repeated no-progress or non-informative returns require bounded reassessment of frame/grant/dependency/evidence gap and an authorised decision, not endless polling or unchanged-basis repairs. Reduced churn permits no lower assurance/capability and creates no universal accounting gate.
conditions: Executive is coordinating.
exceptions: Unavailable/unreliable notifications or actual supervision duties permit bounded fallback observation.

grounding.quote: | stale basis of a held result, before disposition | for the disposition's conjunction the component has no applicable closed result: a gap, never relabelled `invalid_basis` and never counted as returned

constraints.statement: Use owner-defined outcomes only: changed Product meaning causes re_enter to its owner; stale/substituted basis before activation gives activation_refusal(basis), invalid_basis; evaluation performed on stale/substituted basis has its own invalid_basis or is reactivated currently; stale held result before disposition is a conjunction gap, never relabelled invalid_basis or counted returned. Missing material scope gives out_of_frame at activation under admission law or during evaluation for undeclared material relation/capability. Missing operation authority refuses activation with activation_refusal(authority) or refuses the effect. Unresolved mandatory conflict survives all joins and prevents satisfied conjunction. Executive cannot repair any failure by enlarging its own frame.
conditions: A lock fails before activation, during evaluation or before disposition, as specified.

grounding.quote:
A repair advances the workspace, creates a new
candidate and invalidates the affected results. A released Product, Release
Cut or exact Install stays immutable under its own lifecycle law and imposes
no immutability on the Source Project constructing a successor (P3, P4b).

constraints.statement: An installed Product may lawfully build its successor or another Product while remaining distinct from mutable source and authored Product. Nesting, shared code/actors, imports, tool reachability, labels and equal outputs create no identity, composition edge or authority transfer. Exact basis does not make Source Project immutable: Worker may cumulatively mutate its granted exact source/write territory. Reviewer assesses an exact checkpoint from that workspace. Repair advances source, creates a new candidate and invalidates affected results; released Product/Cut/exact Install immutability remains governed by their lifecycles, not inherited by successor source.

grounding.quote:
The overlap collapses
neither evaluation nor authority (P1, P6, RF-008)

constraints.statement: Shared basis, outcome, checkpoint, affected relations, candidate, evidence and residuals do not collapse authority or evaluations. Executive evaluates activation, priority, boundary effect and disposition; Worker evaluates/performs bounded construction; activated Reviewer assesses exact candidate claims and technical triage. Other RF-009 structures remain distinct, with none added or merged. Active-evaluation notation requires neither Cartesian-product schema nor universal frame runtime.
constraints.uncertainty: The full RF-009 structure list is outside this excerpt.

grounding.quote:
Selecting the configuration makes none of them optional, and no operation
grant lifts them (P6).

constraints.statement: All frame grants, duties, limits and prohibitions apply without exception when selected, including Executive no-mutation, attention duties and Worker/Reviewer exclusions; operation grants lift none. Allocation must be explained against task fit, finite resources and failure assumptions; when one sufficient frame covers the task direct entry applies. Adopting basis records concrete capability envelopes; execution binding supplies declared, measured and honoured resource limits. Constructor self-review is construction output, required assessment is independent, stale results trigger lock revalidation, and refused activation returns cause without Worker result. Other configurations are evaluated against their own task, not distance from this configuration.
conditions: The executive configuration is selected.

grounding.quote:
A
compact result carries every blocker material to delivery, as that rule
requires, in the residuals, stop basis and effect values of a work
result, the findings, counterexamples and residuals of a review result,
and the residuals of a specialist result (P0, P4b, P6).

constraints.statement: Work results name each intended external effect with its ACTIVATION Effects value. Unknown completion, including lost responses, must be reconciled sufficiently for the next dependent action before reactivation or that action. Coordinator uses the ledger and work/review/specialist projections; additional necessary information comes through frame inputs or further bounded evaluation. Compact returns must retain every delivery-material blocker in work residuals/stop basis/effect values, review findings/counterexamples/residuals and specialist residuals.
constraints.uncertainty: The effect-value algebra and detailed reconciliation protocol are referenced, not supplied.
conditions: An effect has uncertain completion or the coordinator's bounded view lacks decision-relevant information.

grounding.quote:
Qualification may
be staged

allowed: Qualification may be staged, with each verdict confined to the exact evaluated functions, branches and populations.
Prior exemplars may be optional comparison evidence after freeze.
forbidden: Giving unevaluated functions or branches a whole-method verdict.
Treating exemplars as mandatory target answers without explicit governing-basis equivalence requirements.

grounding.quote:
A project may adopt this profile or define another frame configuration
(§16).

allowed: A project may adopt this profile or define another frame configuration.
Select the executive configuration where it fits; other configurations may use other names, frames or topology and are judged against their own tasks.
A local axioms file may carry the authorised adoption decision.
forbidden: Treating this configuration as the method default.
Treating decision carriage as constitutional ownership.
Treating departure from method law as local frame selection rather than a separate method basis or recorded non-conformance.

grounding.quote:
Accumulated delivery practice and observed failure may inform frame
selection, qualification and revision. That evidence does not become method
authority, and it imports none of the originating consumer's architecture,
names, actors, topology, runtime, artifacts or work stages into this
generic profile (P6, P2).

allowed: Delivery practice and observed failures may inform frame selection, qualification and revision.
forbidden: Promoting evidence or precedent to method or semantic authority.
Importing the originating consumer's architecture, names, actors, topology, runtime, artifacts or work stages into the generic profile.

grounding.quote:
One project may instantiate several frames in one
family. One declared frame may cover several families only when its
evaluation and result relations preserve every material distinction instead
of flattening them behind one broad label (P1, RF-008).

allowed: One project may instantiate multiple frames within one family.
One declared frame may cover multiple families when evaluation and result relations preserve every material distinction.
forbidden: Flattening material distinctions behind a broad label.
Inferring concrete carrier, actor, architecture, owner or implementation from a family.

grounding.quote:
The frame may be occupied by direct human authority or by a bounded proxy
admitted under the proxy grant of EVALUATION §5, ACTIVATION §1 (Roles and
delegation), identity law and current project authority.

allowed: Direct human authority may occupy Executive.
A bounded proxy may occupy Executive when admitted under EVALUATION §5, ACTIVATION delegation, identity law and current project authority.
forbidden: Treating Executive as a universal semantic owner, controller, manager service or runtime observer.
Changing owner-defined execution semantics, result causes, core mappings or dispositions through representation choice.

grounding.quote:
The cycle needs no scheduler and no frame engine (RF-016). `M` may hold
parallel activations. Recursion follows declared evaluation dependencies and
bounded refinements; it does not nest or join undifferentiated copies of
every frame.

allowed: Recursion may follow declared evaluation dependencies and bounded refinements.
The cycle requires no scheduler or frame engine; Executive need only acquire the decision-material ledger portion.
forbidden: Nesting or joining undifferentiated copies of every frame.
Dropping open obligations because a stop or cycle end occurs.

grounding.quote:
Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
not (P2, P6).

residuals.uncertainty: The thirteen consumer lists point to unsupplied FOUNDATIONS, SPEC_METHOD, CONFORMANCE, ASSURANCE, ACTIVATION, REFERENCE_FRAME, AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS, PRODUCT_DEFINITION, RELEASE and Executive sections. Their local assertions include tenant conformance without outside-contract identity, structure-preservation claims separate from conformance, no second profile qualification process, digest identity without semantic authority, no unassessed actual-use evidence and no unrun case pass. The exact cross-file applications, discriminator inventories and owning procedures remain unresolved. The prose saying CONFORMANCE cases are choices in the 'last two rows' is ambiguous after the table's reconstruction-return row; no row reassignment is inferred.
residuals.consequence: Interpretation retains stated rules and consumer restrictions but cannot establish full equivalence definitions, formal categorical obligations, trial inventories or linked consumers' complete law.

grounding.quote:
The qualification population is every function and failure relation the
method claims (REFERENCE_FRAME §5), each with its required representative
observations (P6):

residuals.uncertainty: The table states representative observations rather than complete formal method-function definitions. Full closed-pressure domains, conjunction veto/deferral causes, activation reconstruction and post-exposure revision classifications reside in unsupplied owners. The five-family schema does not encode these as executable judgments, traversals or transformations.
residuals.consequence: Named operations, result distinctions, representative tests and source falsifiers are retained descriptively; no executable function, proof or assessment is created.

grounding.quote:
Where this profile conflicts with an owning
clause, the owning clause controls and this profile requires revision (P6).

residuals.uncertainty: The owner table identifies authoritative locations without supplying their complete content: frame principles/outcomes, core algebra, admission/delegation, bounded-frame conservation, independent-review triggers, exact assurance populations, design-derived unit proof, foundation selection, testing populations, identity/proxy grants and release acceptance. No conflict determination or inherited permission is inferred from the citations.
residuals.consequence: Ownership is retained without importing unsupplied definitions or treating this optional profile as an independent execution or acceptance authority.

grounding.quote:
a reader of this profile sees which of its rules rest on the
commitments and imported families, and which are choices this profile or
the adopting Product makes, so no profile choice is presented as following
from the foundations (P6, P2).

residuals.uncertainty: Consumer lists §§9–22, ODD, PROFILES and external cases mostly exceed supplied source. The trace references eight handoff projections, eight diagnostic questions, twenty-six qualification obligations and twenty-four closure conditions without their full definitions. Source distinctions that no separate consumer applies to steel-thread strategy or effect reconciliation are retained by not inventing such edges. The phrase 'Three parts add no rule of their own' explicitly identifies ASSURANCE-owned terms and the trace but does not clearly enumerate three parts; the third is unresolved.
residuals.consequence: The nineteen-row trace is retained as source-authored rationale and ownership data, with its material consequences represented; detailed consumer inventory is not expanded into fabricated local endpoints or claimed complete proofs.

grounding.quote:
Testing frame, authoritative Product path and material combinatorial
complexity are tier-2 terms defined in ASSURANCE §7.

residuals.uncertainty: ASSURANCE §7's definitions are not supplied; nearby mentions of testing frames do not determine authoritative Product path or material combinatorial complexity.
residuals.consequence: The three terms retain imported ownership only; their detailed meanings cannot be reconstructed here.

grounding.quote:
Ending the cycle establishes neither Product success nor acceptance. A
closed evaluation may be `falsified`; an applicable stop may leave required
evaluations without results.

residuals.uncertainty: Pseudocode, durable update ordering, concurrency, owner-retained residuals and stop handling exceed this schema's executable expressiveness. No concrete U, M, stop, governing retention decision or result ledger is supplied.
residuals.consequence: The cycle's obligations, alternative exits and durable result distinctions are represented without executing the loop, asserting scheduling behaviour or proving eventual completion.
